title: AI-driven biomarker discovery: enhancing precision in cancer diagnosis and prognosis

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《AI-driven biomarker discovery: enhancing precision in cancer diagnosis and prognosis》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】This commentary aims to clarify how AI is improving the identification of novel biomarkers for optimal early diagnosis, focused treatment, and improved clinical outcomes, while also addressing certain obstacles and ethical issues related to the application of artificial intelligence in oncology.

evidence.text: This commentary aims to clarify how AI is improving the identification of novel biomarkers for optimal early diagnosis, focused treatment, and improved clinical outcomes, while also addressing certain obstacles and ethical issues related to the application of artificial intelligence in oncology.

sections.title: 研究方法

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】The advancement of biomarker discovery methodologies with AI seeks to transform cancer by improving patient survival rates through enhanced early diagnosis and targeted therapy.
